creature.deepcharter.tally_approach: Clicking behind you, counting. A Tally has found your ore.
creature.deepcharter.tally_clamp_pod: A Tally has clamped to the cargo hatch. Drill into rock to cut it off.
creature.deepcharter.tally_clamp_foot: A Tally has clamped to your pack. Strike it.
creature.deepcharter.tally_broken: The Tally comes apart. It drops nothing.
creature.deepcharter.tally_sample: The Tally took one %s as a quality sample, and is gone.
creature.deepcharter.approach: Something walks toward the pod. Light the pod, or be ready to drill.
creature.deepcharter.grab: Something has hold of the hull. Drill into rock to cut it off, or get out and strike it.
creature.deepcharter.dead: It is gone. The hull is clear.
